segments.text: Where was the Statue of Liberty made?
segments.translation: 自由女神像是在哪里制造的？

segments.text: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty,
segments.translation: 世界上最著名的纪念碑之一——自由女神像

segments.text: was presented to the USA in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
segments.translation: 是19世纪由法国人民赠送给美国的。

segments.text: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
segments.translation: 这座由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计的巨大雕像花了10年时间才完成。

segments.text: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
segments.translation: 实际的雕像是用铜做的，由埃菲尔特别建造的金属框架支撑。

segments.text: Before it could be transported to the United States,
a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
segments.translation: 必须为它找到一个安置地点，并建造一个基座。

segments.text: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
segments.translation: 选择的地点是纽约港入口处的一个小岛。

segments.text: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
segments.translation: 到1884年，一座151英尺高的雕像已经在巴黎竖立起来了。

segments.text: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
segments.translation: 第二年，它被拆开运往美国。

segments.text: the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi.
segments.translation: 雕像被重新组装起来，由巴托尔迪正式赠送给美国人民。

segments.text: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty
segments.translation: 从那时起，这座伟大的纪念碑就一直是自由的象征，

segments.text: for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
segments.translation: 对于数百万经过纽约港在美国安家落户的人来说。
